Hi Emily — thanks for the note and context. Short answer below; attaching our quick ratecard for Q3.

Baseline hosted API rates (per 1M tokens):
- Redwood-1-small: $2.50 input / $5.00 output
- Redwood-1-medium: $5.00 input / $10.00 output
- Redwood-1-large: $12.00 input / $24.00 output

Notes:
- We bill input/output separately (you’ll see separate counts on the invoice). Streaming responses are billed on output tokens as they are generated; any network/keepalive overhead is negligible and not separately charged.
- Peak throughput: small/medium models are optimized for low-latency micro-batches; large supports higher per-request concurrency but higher unit cost. We can share latency P50/P95 numbers for your sequence length if you want.
- Standard discounts: self-serve customers are on list rates; for committed volume we offer step discounts: 5-10% at 10M+ monthly, 15%+ for 50M+ or multi-month reserved commitments. For your pilot (5M/mo) we can offer a one-time pilot discount — happy to propose.

Attachments: RI-hosted-ratecard-Q3-2026.pdf (high-level table + model profiles)

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min sync with Aditya (pricing lead) and Marissa (solutions engineer) to map cost to expected sequence lengths and traffic shape. Here is my scheduling link: https://calendly.com/neha-kapoor/30min

Best,
